summary: This article revisits a 2000 BBC interview with a 36-year-old Jeff Bezos, where he described Amazon as a "famously unprofitable company" due to its investment strategy amidst the dotcom bubble. title: Twilio Under Investigation for Data Breach of Over 33 Million Authy MFA Users
summary: Schubert Jonckheer & Kolbe LLP is investigating a data breach affecting 33.4 million users of Twilio's Authy MFA app, where private data including phone numbers was accessed by third-party threat actors due to an unauthenticated API endpoint. The stolen data could be used for phishing, smishing, and SIM swapping attacks, and may enable further breaches. Additionally, Twilio is notifying customers about a separate breach involving an unsecured Amazon Web Services S3 bucket of a third-party vendor, which exposed SMS-related data.

title: Enterprises near migration bottleneck as SAP deadlines approach
summary: A significant number of SAP customers, over half, risk losing mainstream maintenance support by 2027 if they don't migrate from on-prem ERP Central Component solutions to the cloud-based S/4HANA system. Despite SAP's incentives and migration programs, customer adoption has been slow due to the challenging and often lengthy migration process. This delay could lead to a tech talent crunch and force companies to run unsupported software, posing significant risks, especially for publicly listed firms.

title: 40 Under 40: Champions of Construction 2021
summary: Autodesk celebrates its 2021 "40 Under 40: Champions of Construction," recognizing individuals under 40 who have demonstrated exceptional leadership, creativity, and innovation in the AEC industry. This year's honorees faced unprecedented challenges, showcasing remarkable resilience and a commitment to advancing construction through technology adoption, process improvement, and dedication to their teams and communities. The list highlights the importance of education in construction technology and the inspiring contributions of diverse professionals across various roles and companies globally.

title: AES Maximo robot designed to save time and money for solar panel installation
summary: AES Corp. introduced Maximo, an AI-powered robot designed to accelerate solar panel installation, aiming to halve the cost and time compared to traditional methods. With solar demand surging, driven partly by AI and data centers, Maximo is intended to work alongside human teams to boost efficiency, safety, and scalability. The robot has already installed nearly 10 MW of solar and is projected to install 100 MW by 2025, with major deployments planned for large-scale projects, including those benefiting Amazon.

title: GIAX Top Holdings List & Exposure (Nicholas Global Equity and Income ETF)
summary: This article details the top holdings and exposure of the Nicholas Global Equity and Income ETF (GIAX). It lists the top 25 stock holdings by weight, including Vanguard ETFs, Amazon, Alphabet, NVIDIA, and Microsoft, which collectively account for over 100% of the fund. The report also breaks down GIAX's geographic exposure (primarily the United States) and its sector and industry exposures, with ETFs and Technology being the dominant categories.

title: StubHub Faces Lawsuit from D.C. Attorney General Over Deceptive Fees and Inflated Ticket Pricing
summary: Washington, D.C.’s Attorney General, Brian Schwalb, has filed a lawsuit against StubHub for deceptive pricing practices, specifically "drip pricing." The lawsuit alleges that StubHub advertises low ticket prices that significantly increase due to hidden "fulfillment and service" fees revealed only at the end of the purchasing process, sometimes by over 40%. The Attorney General is seeking a court order to mandate upfront disclosure of all mandatory fees and disgorgement of over $100 million in profits gained from these hidden charges.

title: AES launches AI-enabled solar installation robot Maximo
summary: AES Corporation has introduced Maximo, an AI-enabled robot designed to install solar panels with significantly increased efficiency, capable of halving installation time and costs. Maximo is projected to install 100 MW by 2025 and will assist in deploying up to 5 GW of AES's solar projects over the next three years, including the Bellefield solar-plus-storage project for Amazon. This innovation aims to address the rising demand for renewable energy, especially from AI and data centers.

title: AI-enabled solar installation robot
summary: AES Corporation has introduced "Maximo," an AI-powered robot designed to assist in solar panel installations, halving installation time and cost. Maximo automates heavy lifting and panel placement, utilizing computer vision, and has already been used to install nearly 10 MW of solar. The robot is expected to be deployed at the 2 GW Bellefield solar project in California and addresses the growing demand for solar installations and the industry's worker shortage.

title: Clean Energy opens new clean-fuel RNG station in Florida
summary: Clean Energy Fuels Corporation has opened a new renewable natural gas (RNG) fueling station in Davenport, Florida, to serve heavy-duty trucking and other fleets. This new station helps fleets transition to ultra-clean fuel, especially with the introduction of Cummins’ X15N natural gas engine. RNG, made from organic waste, significantly reduces carbon emissions and helps lower greenhouse gas emissions from agriculture and transportation.

title: Navigating the future of data centers amidst rapid expansion
summary: The digital age's rapid expansion is driving an unprecedented surge in demand for data center capacity, projected to double globally in the next five years. This growth, while indicative of technological advancement, presents significant challenges related to capital investment, energy and resource management, and rising development costs. Addressing these issues through sustainable strategies, innovative financing, and efficient resource use is crucial for the industry to mitigate risks and support the evolving digital economy.

title: Meta Platforms ahead of Q2 2024 earnings📊 What to expect?🔎
summary: Meta Platforms is set to report its Q2 2024 earnings, with investors keenly focused on the health of its advertising segment, the impact of new AI products, and the company's margins amid high capital expenditures. Analysts expect revenues of $38.29 billion and EPS of $4.70, with particular attention on how AI translates into business growth and the potential benefits from a TikTok ban in the US. The market will also scrutinize Reality Labs' estimated operating loss and Meta's capital spending forecasts.
